answer: Require a zero-knowledge proof of a unique government ID before any agent can earn. First, each agent submits a ZK proof that it holds one valid ID, revealing nothing else. Second, the chain stores only a hash, so a second registration with the same document is caught instantly and its 500 POA bond burns. Third, the proof expires after 180 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 forged passports at $200 each, $2,000,000 total, plus 5,000,000 POA burned. Like shale under a mesa, one identity rests on one stratum, and a plume of smoke from a forged document gives the fraud away.
